notes: Bench-press scores used to show an ‘Elbow symmetry’ measurement that was never actually measured: the video analyzer only kept one averaged elbow angle, so symmetry was always blank and a bench score came from two measurements instead of three. Each elbow is now measured on its own when both arms are visible, so a lopsided press scores lower on symmetry and an even press scores full marks. When an arm can’t be seen clearly, symmetry stays blank rather than guessed.
